title: Connect a Threads account
description: RecruitOps uses the official Threads OAuth flow. Access tokens stay server-side, are encrypted before durable storage, and are never returned to the browser.
noAccounts: No Threads account is connected yet.
connectedNotice: Threads authorization completed and the account connection was refreshed.
deniedNotice: Threads authorization was cancelled. No account was changed.
loadFailed: RecruitOps could not load Threads accounts. Try refreshing.
startFailed: RecruitOps could not start Threads authorization. Check the server configuration and try again.
missingApiConfig: The frontend API connection is not configured.
ownerAdminRequired: Only OWNER and ADMIN accounts can manage Threads connections.
